lines.en: label halloween5:
: I’m home.
lines.zh: : 我回来了。

lines.en: I open the door after a relatively long walk back from my semi-date with Kaori.
lines.zh: 和 Kaori 那场半吊子约会结束后，我走了挺长一段路才到家，然后推开了门。

lines.en: A date that may or may not have ended with me being closer to a chicken than probably ever before.
lines.zh: 那场约会最后有没有让我和一只鸡贴得比以往任何时候都近，我也不好说。

lines.en: I’m thankful that I didn’t hit my head too hard, though.
lines.zh: 不过我还是挺庆幸的，头撞得不算太重。

lines.en: My day would really take a turn for the worse if I started seeing things that weren’t there or something along those lines.
lines.zh: 要是我开始看见一些并不存在的东西之类的，那今天可就真要急转直下了。

lines.en: scene dolphinhome1
: Oh dear God no.
lines.zh: : 哦，天哪，不要吧。

lines.en: : Welcome home.
lines.zh: : 欢迎回家。

lines.en: : It talks, too?
lines.zh: : 它还会说话？

lines.en: Is it possible for a concussion to take this long in order to set in?
lines.zh: 脑震荡有可能潜伏这么久才发作吗？

lines.en: Do concussions even cause people to hallucinate?
lines.zh: 脑震荡真的会让人产生幻觉吗？

lines.en: What sort of medical condition would cause me to see a dolphin in the middle of my living room?
lines.zh: 到底是什么样的病，才会让我在客厅正中央看见一只海豚？

lines.en: : U-Umm...you look really pale all of a sudden...
lines.zh: : 那……那个……你的脸色突然变得好苍白……

lines.en: : Are you okay?...
lines.zh: : 你还好吗？……

lines.en: : Should I call Ami?...
lines.zh: : 要不要我叫 Ami 来？……

lines.en: : Who are you and why do you know my [niece]?
lines.zh: : 你是谁，为什么认识我[niece]？

lines.en: scene dolphinhome2
I approach the dolphin.
lines.zh: 我朝那只海豚走过去。

lines.en: That is not a sentence I imagined I’d be saying today.
lines.zh: 这可真不是我以前想过自己会在今天说出口的一句话。

lines.en: Or ever.
lines.zh: 或者说，这辈子都没想过。

lines.en: : S-Sensei?...
lines.zh: : S——Sensei？……

lines.en: : You’re no student of mine.
lines.zh: : 你不是我的学生。

lines.en: : Go back to the sea where you came from.
lines.zh: : 回你来的那片海里去吧。

lines.en: : The...sea?
: Oh!
scene dolphinhome3
The dolphin removes its head and I’m suddenly face to face with someone else I don’t know.
lines.zh: 海豚把头摘了下来，我突然就和一个我不认识的人面对面了。

lines.en: She looks kind of like Sana, but with one extra eye.
lines.zh: 她看起来有点像 Sana，只是多了一只眼睛。

lines.en: : Um...sorry about that...
lines.zh: : 嗯……抱歉吓到你了……

lines.en: : It probably felt weird...coming home and seeing a dolphin in the living room.
lines.zh: : 回家一进门就在客厅里看见一只海豚，感觉应该挺怪的……

lines.en: : Do I know you?
lines.zh: : 我认识你吗？

lines.en: scene dolphinhome4
: O-Of course you know me! I’m Sana!
lines.zh: : 你——你当然认识我！我是 Sana！

lines.en: : M-Maybe I should call Ami after all?
lines.zh: : 我——我还是叫 Ami 来吧？

lines.en: : If you don’t even recognize me, then...
lines.zh: : 如果你连我都认不出来的话，那……

lines.en: : Oh, Sana. Yeah, I know you.
lines.zh: : 哦，Sana。是啊，我认识你。

lines.en: : I’ve just never seen you with your hair not covering your face before.
lines.zh: : 我只是从没见过你头发没有遮住脸的样子。

lines.en: scene dolphinhome5
: Well, it’s...umm...really hot inside of this costume...so I kind of had to pull it back...
lines.zh: : 嗯，那个……这套衣服里面真的很热……所以我只好把头发扎起来了……

lines.en: : I hope I don’t look too weird...
lines.zh: : 希望我看起来不要太奇怪……

lines.en: : You’re wearing half of a dolphin’s body. Of course you look weird.
lines.zh: : 你穿着半只海豚的身体。当然看起来奇怪了。

lines.en: : ...That’s not what I meant.
lines.zh: : ……我不是那个意思。

lines.en: : Why a dolphin, though? And did you really make this with stuff you bought from the mall?
lines.zh: : 不过为什么是海豚？这真是你用从商场买的东西做的？

lines.en: scene dolphinhome6
: Of course not...I’m not talented enough to make something like this...
lines.zh: : 当然不是……我没有那种本事做这种东西……

lines.en: : I...couldn’t find anything I liked at the mall, so I got this from my mom.
lines.zh: : 我……在商场里找不到喜欢的东西，所以这是从我妈妈那儿拿的。

lines.en: : Would you mind explaining to me why your mom owns a dolphin suit?
lines.zh: : 你能解释一下为什么你妈妈会有一套海豚装吗？

lines.en: : I think she got it from...Makoto’s mom...
lines.zh: : 我想她是……从 Makoto 的妈妈那儿拿的……

lines.en: : I mean, I guess that makes slightly more sense given that we’re dealing with Maki, but I’d still like to know why she owns a thing like this.
lines.zh: : 嗯，既然牵扯到 Maki，那倒是稍微说得通一点，但我还是想知道她为什么会拥有这种东西。

lines.en: : So would I but...I’m not really in the...position to be asking any questions when I just...need a costume.
lines.zh: : 我也想知道，可是……我本来就只是……需要一套装扮，实在没什么立场去问东问西。

lines.en: : Are you...really not going to dress up, Sensei?
lines.zh: : Sensei 你……真的不打算打扮吗？

lines.en: : I’m not. I don’t really think something like that suits my personality.
lines.zh: : 不打算。我觉得那种东西不太适合我的性格。

lines.en: : But...you’re still coming to the party...right?
lines.zh: : 可是……你还是会来派对的……对吧？

lines.en: : Right. I wouldn’t miss the chance to see everyone’s costumes even if it meant the death of me.
lines.zh: : 对。就算要我的命，我也不会错过看大家装扮的机会。

lines.en: scene dolphinhome7
: That’s...kind of weird...
lines.zh: : 那……有点奇怪……

lines.en: : What will be even weirder is if everyone else dresses like some sort of sea creature as well.
lines.zh: : 更奇怪的是，如果其他人也都打扮成某种海洋生物的话。

lines.en: : Never fear, Sensei! Behold, my wonderful non-sea-creature costume!
lines.zh: : 别怕，Sensei！看吧，我这身精彩的、绝非海洋生物的装扮！

lines.en: scene black
Oh good, Ayane is here.
lines.zh: 哦太好了，Ayane 也在。

lines.en: I was beginning to worry that Sana was just alone in my house for some reason.
lines.zh: 我刚才还开始担心 Sana 是不是不知怎么地一个人待在我家里。

lines.en: I’m sure Ayane has some sort of slightly provocative costume that she’ll use in her favor to catch my-
lines.zh: 我敢肯定 Ayane 会穿某种略带挑逗的装扮，好用来吸引我的——

lines.en: scene dolphinhome8
: Mi'lady.
lines.zh: : 小姐。

lines.en: : What ever happened to normal costumes?
lines.zh: : 正常的装扮都去哪儿了？

lines.en: : Why are two cute [teenage]girls in my house wearing a suit of armor and suit of...dolphin?
lines.zh: : 为什么我家里两个可爱的[teenage]女孩，一个穿着一身盔甲，一个穿着一身……海豚？

lines.en: scene dolphinhome9
: What’s the matter, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 怎么了，Sensei？

lines.en: : You weren’t expecting me to be wearing something more...risque, were you?
lines.zh: : 你该不会是期待我穿得更……暴露一点吧？

lines.en: : And be careful how you respond. Sana is right next to us and still has virgin ears.
lines.zh: : 回答的时候小心点。Sana 就在我们旁边，她的耳朵还纯洁着呢。

lines.en: : If we’re going to talk more about what you {i}wish{/i} I was wearing, perhaps we should take this to the bedroom?
lines.zh: : 如果我们还要继续聊你{i}希望{/i}我穿什么的话，也许该去卧室聊？

lines.en: scene dolphinhome10
: Umm...my ears aren’t-
lines.zh: : 嗯……我的耳朵才不——

lines.en: : Please tell me that at least Ami and Maya are wearing more...traditional Halloween costumes.
lines.zh: : 请告诉我，至少 Ami 和 Maya 穿的是比较……传统的万圣节装扮。

lines.en: scene dolphinhome11
: Oh, I don’t really know what Maya is going to be.
lines.zh: : 哦，我还真不知道 Maya 要扮什么。

lines.en: : She said she had a plan and that she has everything she needs in the dorm.
lines.zh: : 她说她有个计划，需要的东西都在宿舍里。

lines.en: : Ami’s just going to be Sailor Moon.
lines.zh: : Ami 就扮美少女战士。

lines.en: : Sailor what?
lines.zh: : 美少女什么？

lines.en: scene dolphinhome12
: Sailor Moon. From that anime you used to watch with us when we were little.
lines.zh: : 美少女战士。就是我们小时候你陪我们一起看的那部动画里的。

lines.en: : That’s when Ami started putting her hair in twintails, remember?
lines.zh: : Ami 就是从那时候开始梳双马尾的，记得吗？

lines.en: : Because you always talked about how you thought Sailor Moon was cute and-
lines.zh: : 因为你总说你觉得美少女战士很可爱，然后——

lines.en: scene dolphinhome13
: Wait a minute. That means that she’s trying to get you to think she’s cute with her Halloween costume as well.
lines.zh: : 等等。也就是说，她也想用万圣节装扮来让你觉得她可爱。

lines.en: : She knew I’d be at a disadvantage since you can’t gaze at my beautiful figure through this suit of armor and is using that against me.
lines.zh: : 她知道我吃了亏——因为穿着这身盔甲，你就没法欣赏我的曼妙身姿了——所以她在利用这一点。

lines.en: : But...I think...the suit of armor fits you, Ayane...
lines.zh: : 可是……我觉得……这身盔甲挺适合你的，Ayane……

lines.en: scene dolphinhome14
: Is that supposed to make me feel good?!
lines.zh: : 你这是在安慰我吗？！

lines.en: : Why do I look like I belong in a suit of armor?!
lines.zh: : 我为什么看起来就那么适合穿盔甲？！

lines.en: : You could always just go as something else, you know.
lines.zh: : 你其实也可以换个别的东西扮的，你知道吧。

lines.en: scene dolphinhome13
: I absolutely can not. Especially after Geoffrey went through the trouble of removing this suit from where it was mounted.
lines.zh: : 绝对不行。尤其是 Geoffrey 还费了那么大劲把这身盔甲从陈列架上取下来。

lines.en: : I owe it to him to follow through with my choice of costume. Even if it’s extremely hard and uncomfortable to walk around in.
lines.zh: : 我欠他一个人情，必须坚持自己选的装扮。哪怕穿着它走路又硬又难受。

lines.en: : If it’s that uncomfortable, just take it off now.
lines.zh: : 既然那么难受，现在就脱了吧。

lines.en: : There’s no need to be walking around as a knight twenty-four hours before your party starts.
lines.zh: : 离派对开始还有整整二十四小时，没必要现在就穿着骑士装到处走。

lines.en: : Same thing with Sana and her dolphin costume.
lines.zh: : Sana 和她的海豚装也一样。

lines.en: scene dolphinhome15
: That’s true. I suppose now that I’ve confirmed that it fits, there’s no reason for me to stay inside of it anymore.
lines.zh: : 说得也是。既然已经确认合身了，我也没理由再穿着它了。

lines.en: : Besides, I don’t mind you seeing me in my underwear or anything like that.
lines.zh: : 再说了，我穿内衣的样子被你看到也无所谓。

lines.en: : You’re...not wearing anything else under that besides your underwear?
lines.zh: : 你……那底下除了内衣什么都没穿？

lines.en: : Isn’t the metal...cold? Or uncomfortable?
lines.zh: : 金属不是……很凉吗？还是说很不舒服？

lines.en: : Extremely. I’d much prefer being in Sana’s costume right now.
lines.zh: : 非常凉。我现在宁可穿 Sana 那套。

lines.en: : She’s also in only her underwear beneath that, but probably much warmer than I am at the moment.
lines.zh: : 她那套底下也只穿了内衣，但肯定比我暖和多了。

lines.en: scene dolphinhome16
: Wh-why are you telling him something like that?!
lines.zh: : 你——你为什么要跟他说这种事？！

lines.en: : What’s wrong? It’s not like he can see through clothes or anything.
lines.zh: : 怎么了？他又不能透视衣服什么的。

lines.en: : And if he could, I’m sure he’d much prefer looking at you through your dress rather than through the mascot for Sexy Land.
lines.zh: : 就算能，我敢说他宁可透过裙子看你，也不想透过 Sexy Land 的吉祥物看你。

lines.en: : What the heck is Sexy Land?!
lines.zh: : Sexy Land 到底是什么鬼？！

lines.en: : Hm? It's the name written over the costume's logo.
lines.zh: : 嗯？就是这套衣服标志上写的名字啊。

lines.en: : You really didn't notice?
lines.zh: : 你真的没注意到？

lines.en: scene dolphinhome17
: Wha-?!
: Why would someone make a dolphin the mascot for a place called S-S-S-Sexy Land?!
lines.zh: : 为什么会有人拿海豚来当一家叫性——性感乐园的地方的吉祥物啊？！

lines.en: : This makes no sense!
lines.zh: : 这完全说不通！

lines.en: : I’ve actually heard that having sex with a dolphin is really close to what it feels like to have sex with a girl.
lines.zh: : 我其实听说过，和海豚做爱的感觉，跟和女孩做爱非常接近。

lines.en: scene dolphinhome18
: WHY IS THAT A THING?!
lines.zh: : 为什么会有这种说法？！

lines.en: : HOW DO THEY KNOW?!
lines.zh: : 他们是怎么知道的？！

lines.en: : Hey, I’m not saying it’s okay to have sex with dolphins.
lines.zh: : 嘿，我可没说和海豚做爱是件好事。

lines.en: : I’m just saying that if a guy gets naked, closes his eyes and trips into a dolphin's vagina, he might not know right away.
lines.zh: : 我只是说，如果一个男的脱光了、闭上眼睛、一头栽进海豚的阴道里，他可能一时半会儿分辨不出来。

lines.en: : WHYAREYOUSTILLTALKINGABOUTTHIS?!
lines.zh: : 你为什么还在说这个啊啊啊？！

lines.en: scene dolphinhome19
: Maybe it would be good to lay off of Sana for a second.
lines.zh: : 也许该让 Sana 先喘口气。

lines.en: : At least until she comes to terms with exactly what she’s wearing.
lines.zh: : 至少等她接受了自己到底穿的是什么再说。

lines.en: : Sounds good to me.
lines.zh: : 我没意见。

lines.en: : Would you have sex with a dolphin, Sensei?
lines.zh: : Sensei，你会和海豚做爱吗？

lines.en: : No?
lines.zh: : 不会？

lines.en: : Is that even a real question?
lines.zh: : 这算什么问题啊？

lines.en: I would have sex with a pony, though. But Ayane doesn't need to know that.
lines.zh: 不过换成小马的话我倒是可以。但这种事 Ayane 不需要知道。

lines.en: : What if the dolphin looked like the girl of your dreams? So basically, what if it looked like me?
lines.zh: : 如果那只海豚长得像你梦中的女孩呢？也就是说，如果它长得像我呢？

lines.en: : I’m not going to have sex with a dolphin, Ayane.
lines.zh: : 我不会和海豚做爱的，Ayane。

lines.en: : Well, that's good.
lines.zh: : 嗯，那就好。

lines.en: : I’m...going to get changed...
lines.zh: : 我……去换衣服了……

lines.en: scene dolphinhome20
Sana quickly vanishes into Ami’s room and presumably strips down to her underwear.
lines.zh: Sana 迅速消失在 Ami 的房间里，大概是要把衣服脱到只剩内衣。

lines.en: I try to fantasize about it, but I keep landing back on that dolphin fact instead.
lines.zh: 我试着就此展开幻想，但思绪总会重新回到那个关于海豚的冷知识上。

lines.en: There’s no way that’s true, is it?
lines.zh: 那不可能是真的吧？

lines.en: scene dolphinhome21
: Oh my. It appears the two of us are suddenly alone.
lines.zh: : 哎呀。看来突然就剩我们两个了。

lines.en: : Just because everyone else is in Ami’s room doesn’t mean we’re {i}alone{/i}, Ayane.
lines.zh: : 其他人都在 Ami 房间里，不代表我们就{i}独处{/i}了，Ayane。

lines.en: : It’s not everyone, it’s just Sana.
lines.zh: : 不是其他人，只有 Sana。

lines.en: : Ami and Maya went to the convenience store to get snacks for tonight.
lines.zh: : Ami 和 Maya 去便利店买今晚的零食了。

lines.en: : Tonight? But the party is tomorrow.
lines.zh: : 今晚？派对不是明天吗？

lines.en: : Oh, she didn’t tell you?
lines.zh: : 哦，她没跟你说吗？

lines.en: : We’re all sleeping over and watching horror movies and stuff tonight.
lines.zh: : 我们今晚要一起过夜，看恐怖片什么的。

lines.en: if sanadorm30 == True:
: I’m sure Sana is thrilled about that. She loves horror movies.
lines.zh: : 我敢说 Sana 一定乐坏了。她最爱看恐怖片。

lines.en: scene dolphinhome22
: How...do you know that?
lines.zh: : 你……怎么知道的？

lines.en: : That's not something she normally tells anyone.
lines.zh: : 这种事她平时可不会告诉任何人。

lines.en: : Are you two getting closer or something?
lines.zh: : 你们两个是走得更近了还是怎么的？

lines.en: : It’s just...come up in conversation before.
lines.zh: : 只是……以前聊天时提过。

lines.en: : I see...
lines.zh: : 这样啊……

lines.en: scene dolphinhome23
: Well, either way...
lines.zh: : 嗯，不管怎样……

lines.en: : Did you want to maybe...watch some with us or something?
lines.zh: : 你要不要……也和我们一起看几部什么的？

lines.en: : Maya will probably complain about there not being enough room for all of us on the couch, but I don’t mind sitting on the floor if I have to.
lines.zh: : Maya 大概会抱怨沙发上挤不下我们所有人，不过如果需要的话，我不介意坐地板。

lines.en: : I just want you to be there so I can hold your hand when I get scared and stuff.
lines.zh: : 我只是想让你在，这样我害怕的时候就能握着你的手什么的。

lines.en: : Are you actually going to get scared from watching a horror movie?
lines.zh: : 你看恐怖片真的会被吓到吗？

lines.en: : I have a hard time believing that for some reason.
lines.zh: : 不知为什么，我很难相信。

lines.en: : Of course not. But I can pretend I am so no one will get mad at me when I jump on you.
lines.zh: : 当然不会。但我可以假装被吓到，这样我扑到你身上时就没人会生气了。

lines.en: : Well, sorry to be the bearer of bad news, but I actually have plans tonight.
lines.zh: : 嗯，抱歉要给你带来坏消息了，不过我今晚其实有安排。

lines.en: scene dolphinhome22
: Plans?
lines.zh: : 安排？

lines.en: : What...kind of plans?
lines.zh: : 什么……样的安排？

lines.en: : A friend of mine is having a Halloween party at her bar.
lines.zh: : 我一个朋友要在她的酒吧里办万圣节派对。

lines.en: : Her...bar?
lines.zh: : 她的……酒吧？

lines.en: scene dolphinhome24
: Are you...
lines.zh: : 你该不会……

lines.en: : Friends with Sana’s mom now?...
lines.zh: : 现在和 Sana 的妈妈是朋友了吧？……

lines.en: ...Right.
lines.zh: ……也对。

lines.en: Of course Ayane would be a little surprised to hear that.
lines.zh: Ayane 听到这个当然会有点惊讶。

lines.en: All this time, she’s been under the impression that her and the rest of the girls are the only ones in my life.
lines.zh: 她一直以为，她和其余那些女孩就是我生活里的全部。

lines.en: It’s probably a bit of a shock hearing that there are others she doesn’t know about.
lines.zh: 听到还有她不认识的其他人，大概确实有点冲击。

lines.en: But as long as I downplay the fact that I’ve spent enough time with Sara to warrant going to her place for a Halloween party, I’m sure I can console Ayane to at least...some extent.
lines.zh: 但只要我淡化“我和 Sara 已经熟到能去她家参加万圣节派对”这件事，我相信至少……能在某种程度上安抚 Ayane。

lines.en: : I am.
: Just friends, though. So don’t worry.
lines.zh: : 不过只是朋友。所以别担心。

lines.en: : Of course I’m going to worry. She’s really pretty.
lines.zh: : 我当然会担心。她真的很漂亮。

lines.en: : She’s like a grown-up Sana and Sana is already super cute.
lines.zh: : 她就像长大版的 Sana，而 Sana 本来就超级可爱了。

lines.en: : You’re telling me I need to compete with a grown woman now, too?
lines.zh: : 你是说，我现在还得和一个成年女人竞争？

lines.en: : You’re not competing with anyone.
lines.zh: : 你不用和任何人竞争。

lines.en: : You’ll always have a special place in my life, Ayane. There’s not really anyone that could replace you.
lines.zh: : 你在我生命里永远有一个特别的位置，Ayane。真的没有人能取代你。

lines.en: That might sound like a lie, but that much is actually true.
lines.zh: 这话听着也许像谎话，但这一点确实是真的。

lines.en: Sure, she might interpret that as “There is no one else I’m romantically involved with,” but what I really mean is that she’s like...
lines.zh: 当然，她可能会理解成“我没有别的恋人”，但我真正的意思是，她就像是……

lines.en: The closest someone can get to being family without actually being family.
lines.zh: 一个人能在没有血缘的情况下，最接近家人的存在。

lines.en: She’s here almost every day and has obsessed over me longer than anyone.
lines.zh: 她几乎每天都在这里，而且迷恋我的时间比任何人都长。

lines.en: Even Ami took a little while to start showing her true colors. Ayane's been head over heels since the beginning.
lines.zh: 就连 Ami 也是过了一阵子才露出真面目。而 Ayane 从一开始就神魂颠倒了。

lines.en: So of course she has a special place in my heart.
lines.zh: 所以她当然在我心里占有一个特别的位置。

lines.en: scene dolphinhome25
: When you say it like that...I really can’t worry at all, can I?
lines.zh: : 你都这么说了……我就真的不能担心了，对吧？

lines.en: : That would just make me needy.
lines.zh: : 那样只会显得我很黏人。

lines.en: : Can I text you all night?
lines.zh: : 我可以给你发一整晚短信吗？

lines.en: : Sure, but that also kind of makes you needy.
lines.zh: : 可以，不过那也挺黏人的。

lines.en: : Can I text you after the movie, then?
lines.zh: : 那我看完电影可以给你发短信吗？

lines.en: : Or, better yet, can I “sleepwalk” into your room in the middle of the night and sleep there with you?
lines.zh: : 或者，更好一点，我半夜“梦游”进你房间，和你一起睡在那儿，可以吗？

lines.en: : You can do whatever you want. I figured that’s what you’ll wind up doing anyway, so I’m at least grateful for the warning.
lines.zh: : 你想做什么都行。反正我猜你最后也会这么干，所以至少谢谢你提前打招呼。

lines.en: scene dolphinhome26
: Heheh! It’s settled then!
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿！那就这么定了！

lines.en: : You have fun at your party and there will be a special serving of Ayane that you can have all to yourself once you get home!
lines.zh: : 你在派对上好好玩，等你回家，就会有一份专属的、任你享用的 Ayane！

lines.en: : Thanks. I’m looking forward to it.
lines.zh: : 谢了。我很期待。

lines.en: scene black
Ami and Maya come home roughly twenty minutes later and immediately disappear into Ami’s room to finish her costume.
lines.zh: 大约二十分钟后，Ami 和 Maya 回来了，然后立刻钻进 Ami 的房间去完成她的装扮。

lines.en: The sun is beginning to set, so I figure now is as good a time as any to start heading over to Sara’s.
lines.zh: 太阳开始落山了，所以我觉得现在是动身去 Sara 那儿的好时机。

lines.en: Without saying goodbye to anyone, I put my shoes back on and head out the door.
lines.zh: 我没跟任何人道别，重新穿上鞋就出了门。

lines.en: The first thing I notice when I step outside is the sudden lack of crying cicadas-
lines.zh: 我一出门就注意到的第一件事是：蝉鸣突然消失了——

lines.en: And a breeze so cold I can feel my organs freeze.
lines.zh: 还有一阵冷到我感觉五脏六腑都快冻住的寒风。
